title: Deliver Steel to Guston Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Steel** delivered to **Guston Factory** (industry id 5, near tile 115,93).

A likely supplier is **Bronnpool Steel Mill** (industry id 6, near tile 101,67); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **1,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
